items.html: Also Aba of Beriah does not have a complete Partzuf, only the aspect of VAK, like AA. And the reason is that even in Atzilut itself, when the second coupling of Aba and Ima was there, we have already explained that Ima was squatting upon the fledglings in the complete Partzuf of Atzilut of Tevuna. And indeed, Aba bends his head downward to couple with her. Therefore it is found that the light of the three highest of Aba did not couple with Tevuna except through the bending of Aba's head. Therefore, when that light reached Beriah, the head of Aba was not discernible in it, only his VAK alone.
